you earn 1 Membership Rewards Point for every Rs. 50 spent on all purchases, except Fuel*, Insurance and Other Utility Services
On Spending INR 2500 in a month on our 10X Partner (Zomato), you will earn 500

examples.title: Rs 5,000 general retail spend
examples.why: 1 Membership Rewards point per Rs 50 on eligible spends: 100 x 1 = 100.

examples.title: Rs 1,000 on Zomato (10X)
examples.why: 10X = 10 points per Rs 50 in total (1 regular + 9 additional): 20 x 10 = 200. The 180 additional points count to the Zomato/EaseMyTrip monthly limit (450 additional points, read conservatively from "capped at 500 points").

examples.title: Rs 1,000 on Flipkart (10X)
examples.why: 10X at Flipkart, Uber, BookMyShow and others: 20 x 10 = 200; 180 additional points count to the shared monthly limit (450 additional points).

examples.title: Rs 1,000 on Amazon (5X)
examples.why: 5X = 5 points per Rs 50 in total (1 regular + 4 additional): 20 x 5 = 100; 80 additional points count to the Amazon monthly limit (200 additional points, read conservatively from "capped at 250 points").

examples.title: Rs 2,000 on Flipkart with 400 additional points already earned this month
examples.why: The 10X limit is 500 points per month in all, i.e. 450 additional points at Rs 2,500 (card page: Rs 2,500 at a 10X partner earns 500). 400 used, so 50 additional remain: 40 regular + 50 additional = 90. (A 500-additional reading would pay 140; the lower reading is used, H2.)

examples.title: Rs 1,000 on Zomato after the monthly 10X limit is used
examples.why: The 10X limit is used; the spend still earns the regular 1 point per Rs 50: 20 x 1 = 20.

examples.title: Rs 2,000 fuel
examples.why: Fuel (petrol, diesel, CNG from OMCs) earns no Membership Rewards points.

examples.title: Rs 3,000 electricity bill
examples.why: Other utility services (household electricity, gas, water) earn no points on this card.

examples.title: Rs 10,000 EMI chosen at an electronics store terminal
examples.why: No points on EMI options selected on a merchant website or at a merchant terminal.

examples.title: Rs 2,500 on Zomato in a month (issuer illustration)
examples.why: Card page: "On Spending INR 2500 in a month on our 10X Partner (Zomato), you will earn 500 Membership Rewards points": 50 regular + 450 additional; the monthly 10X limit is now fully used.

examples.title: Rs 2,500 on Amazon in a month (issuer illustration)
examples.why: Card page: "On Spending INR 2500 in a month on our 5X Partner (Amazon), you will earn 250": 50 regular + 200 additional; the monthly 5X limit is now fully used.

research_notes.cardpipeline_says: bonus_reward_points 500 / 500 / 250 per calendar month, then base
research_notes.issuer_says: Partner list: "10X Membership Rewards points will be capped at 500 points per month" (Flipkart, Uber, BookMyShow, Ajio, Nykaa, PVR, BlinkIt, Myntra jointly; Zomato and EaseMyTrip jointly) and 250 for Amazon (5X). Card page: Rs 2,500 at a 10X partner earns 500 and at Amazon 250, which reads as 500/250 points in all (450/200 additional). A bonus-only reading (500/250 additional) would pay up to 50 more.
research_notes.proposed_fix: override (2026-11-06): additional-point limits 450 / 450 / 200 (H2: the lower of the two readings); examples 005, 006, 011-013

research_notes.issuer_says: Partner list PDF (amex.co/seccrewards, as of 28 Aug 2024) names 10X: Zomato, EaseMyTrip, Flipkart, Uber, BookMyShow, Ajio, Nykaa, PVR, BlinkIt, Myntra; 5X: Amazon. Matches CardPipeline (Blinkit, PVR, Myntra confirmed).
Amex Membership Rewards terms do not state rounding of Rs 50 blocks; no rounding example.

research_notes.cardpipeline_says: SafeKey / post-purchase EMI earn rules; Reward Multiplier up to 5X info
research_notes.issuer_says: SafeKey and post-purchase EMI earn, merchant EMI does not; the context cannot tell them apart (D14b, depends_on_txn_attribute). Reward Multiplier discontinued 30 Sep 2026 (Amex notice quoted by Business Today).
